items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did some things with – I don’t know whether the Cabin Boys came in there. No, this is another period. This is a different period. This is much later. But Phil is one of the people that I worked with.

ctx.x: Yeah. Before I ever got to Shearing, there was some other things that I did in between that. In sequence, I can’t quite recall putting them together, the sequence of things I did. But some of the things I did I think happening with the Phil Moore thing. There was that session that I worked with Phil Moore – with the Phil Moore Four.
